overall: Minutes of the Oct. 23, 2014 meeting were accurate but incomplete, omitting an end-of-meeting discussion; the Dec. 17, 2014 minutes were found accurate. Committee ordered to amend the October minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the October 23, 2014 minutes were inaccurate and incomplete in summarizing the eelgrass, Lake Street dock, and new business discussions.
allegations.key_passage: Having reviewed an audio recording of the meeting, we believe that a person who did not attend the meeting could review the minutes and generally understand the Committee's discussions.

allegations.summary: The October 23, 2014 minutes omitted the end-of-meeting new business discussion of a regulation and a community preservation request for a town pier.
allegations.key_passage: Because this entire area of discussion was omitted from the minutes, we find that they do not comply with the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the December 17, 2014 minutes were inaccurate because they supported the personal opinion of the person who drafted them.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Committee has complied with the Open Meeting Law's accuracy requirement.

remedy: Amend the October 23, 2014 minutes to include a summary of the new business discussion, including the regulation and the community preservation request, within 30 days of receipt of the letter.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee to amend its October 23, 2014 meeting minutes to include a summary of the discussion of new business, including discussion of a regulation and a community preservation request.
